answer: Consider a stake bond escrowed per identity as this epoch's mechanism. Step one, each address locks collateral before its first answer. Step two, the bond is slashed when two keys post the same fingerprint. Under the forge rule each key funds itself, the inlet of escrow prices fakes out of the game, and the orchard of co-signatures blocks mass farming. The cost is concrete: forging 10,000 identities would burn 500,000 USDC in bonds and 30 days of staggered verification. Think of a nightclub that makes every guest leave a 200-dollar coat check. Peers only need the ledger they already keep.
